Join us for a special storytelling session for adults.

Our storytellers will share tales that are usually told to children, now presented for an adult audience.

Spend a lovely late-autumn afternoon enjoying a rich selection of stories from Japan and around the world.

Date and Time: Saturday, November 14, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 1:30 p.m. – 3:00 p.m.

Venue: Children's Library, 2nd Floor, Multi-Purpose Hall

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/1114.html
